components.label: Battery
components.description: 3,561 mAh lithium-ion battery. Contains ~10g of cobalt.

components.label: A18 Chip
components.description: Apple A18 Bionic SoC. Rare earth elements in substrate and magnets.

components.label: OLED Display
components.description: 6.1" Super Retina XDR OLED. Indium tin oxide touch layer.

components.label: Logic Board
components.description: Main PCB with tin solder connecting all components.

components.label: Capacitors
components.description: Tantalum capacitors throughout the logic board regulate voltage.

components.label: Taptic Engine
components.description: Tungsten-weighted linear actuator. Produces the haptic buzz.

components.label: Connectors
components.description: Gold-plated USB-C port, antenna connectors, and internal pins.
